title: Toma manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a Toma package (format 1.0, formatVersion 1 to 5): what was recorded and where it lives. Written with its keys in alphabetical order, indented, without escaping "/", optional fields left out (never null). A reader ignores keys it does not know. See docs/format/README.md, "manifest.json".

formatVersion.description: The package's version: 3 when created; 4 with a track of an iPhone or iPad or keyPress events; 5 with two takes or more; 1 and 2 in older packages, until their first edit upgrades them to 3. A reader refuses a version it does not read before the rest.

app.description: The app that created the project.

takes.description: In the order they were recorded.

upgradedFrom.description: Version 3: in a package created at version 1 or 2 and upgraded by its first edit, that version.

projectID.description: Version 3: the project's stable id, 32 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Without it (versions 1 and 2) the id is derived from the manifest.

date.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, in whole seconds: 2026-11-13T16:00:12Z.

rect.description: A rectangle in global points, the origin at the top left of the main display, y down.

cameraStyle.description: How the camera looks: its shape, its size and where it is anchored.

size.description: The camera's side as a fraction of the output's height: 0.17 small, 0.24 medium, 0.33 large.

anchor.description: One of the 8 places at the corners and the middle of the edges; leading is always the left.

take.description: One recording, from Record to Stop.

id.description: take-001, take-002…: also the name of its folder in takes/.

status.description: recording (being recorded, or the app died before closing it), complete or recovered.

cameraStyle.description: Version 2, takes with a camera: how it looks from the start of the take.

track.description: One source recorded into its own files, a new segment at every interruption.

id.description: Unique within the take and the name of its folder: display-<id>, window-<id>, camera, mic, system-audio, system-audio-<app>…; ASCII letters, digits and "-".

kind.description: display, microphone; window, camera, systemAudio (version 2); device, deviceAudio (version 4).

segments.description: In the order of their index.

appBundleID.description: A track of system audio of one app (phase 3): the app's bundle identifier.

appName.description: A track of system audio of one app (phase 3): the app's name.

source.description: What a track recorded: name, and only the fields of its kind.

name.description: The display's, window's (its app and title) or device's visible name.

deviceUniqueID.description: microphone, camera, device, deviceAudio: the device's uniqueID.

globalFrame.description: display, window: where it is, in global points (device: its size in pixels).

pixelScale.description: display, window, device: pixels per point of what was recorded.

bundleIdentifier.description: window (version 2): the bundle identifier of its app.

captureArea.description: display in Area mode (version 2): the area chosen, in global points.

includedBundleIDs.description: systemAudio (version 2): only these apps are recorded.

excludedBundleIDs.description: systemAudio (version 2): every app but these is recorded.

segment.description: One media file of a track, a fragmented QuickTime movie whose time 0 is startHostTime.

index.description: The segment's number within its track, from 1.

file.description: Its path from the package's root, exactly takes/<take>/<track>/seg-NNNN.mov for its index.

startHostTime.description: When its first frame or sample was captured.

endHostTime.description: When it was closed; missing while it is open.

endReason.description: Why it was closed; missing while it is open.

droppedFrames.description: Frames (or blocks of audio) the capture gave that were not written.

heartbeatFrames.description: Frames repeated to keep time moving while the screen did not change.

endReason.description: Why a segment was closed: a flat object with its type and, for some types, their fields at the same level.

type.description: stopped, paused, streamError, writerError, formatChanged, diskFull, recoveredAfterCrash, empty, unreadable, or rotated (only in the Replay's working package, never in a take of the library).

domain.description: streamError and writerError: the NSError's domain.

code.description: streamError and writerError: the NSError's code.

bytes.description: unreadable: the size of the file recovery could not read, which stays as it is.
